english.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken word for a small pack, package, or bundle.

exampleSentences.english: I bought a packet of tea leaves to take home.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我買咗一包茶葉返屋企。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 baau1 caa4 jip6 faan1 uk1 kei2

english.note: Use this when the bag is viewed as a packet, bundle, or quantity of goods rather than primarily as a reusable container.

exampleSentences.english: I bought a bag of rice crackers.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 baau1 mai5 beng2

english.note: Use 包 as the all-purpose physical-package word, including a bundle or a pack of cigarettes.

exampleSentences.english: There's a pack of cigarettes in my backpack.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我背囊入面有一包香煙。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 bui3 nong4 jap6 min6 jau5 jat1 baau1 hoeng1 jin1
